comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. The four inputs carry no family colour: the manual says almost any signal can go in, and what the network makes of it depends on the weights, so nothing about a jack says what belongs there. The output layer's bias is zeroed at construction and a 30Hz high-pass follows the network. Makeup gain is four divided by the number of connected inputs, so unpatching an input makes the rest louder. The randomise button is momentary and its parameter is read every sample, so holding it down rerolls the weights continuously.
